evidenceSource: Completed main CI for this exact source commit. Browser reports decoded from verified SHA256 artifact ZIPs. Snapshot covers current application and exercised test inputs. This evidence does not establish universal equivalence.

checks.name: original templates, image decoders, workers, exports and browser storage
local starter: account, direct overwrite and remembered fresh Toolbox paths
Windows mode: raw API files retain original values and chunk order through the real worker
coding: keyboard, modal guard, result download and stored progress
coding: upload a job and move, rotate and reset its template
Toolbox: retain login inputs and downloads, then create QR Word handouts
Toolbox: CSV keeps exact values and rejects invalid input without stale downloads
Toolbox: codes and booklets produce downloadable original formats

parity: physical zoom, scan panning, template edges, shared position and reset rotation
parity: startup defaults and login regeneration without XML match Windows
parity: full diagnostics survive module changes and export every validation error
parity: preparation cancellation preserves the SQLite working copy
parity: the last coding workspace reopens after reload without selecting the source files again
parity: original result boundary is selectable and the completed job flashes for one second
parity: selected Toolbox input files and options survive closing and reopening the page
Testcenter: group selection and workspace changes cannot export stale groups
parity: Testcenter access can be remembered explicitly and deleted again
